newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Konka 1996 net at 346 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Konka 1996 net at 346 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Konka Group Co Ltd had net profits of 346.04 million yuan ($41.7 million) in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Thursday.

The colour television maker's earnings were equal to 0.95 yuan per share and came on the back of turnover of 5.01 billion yuan in 1996, the exchange said in a notice issued after the close of trading.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards or give comparative figures.
According to Konka's 1995 annual report, the company posted net profits of 268 million yuan on turnover of 3.48 billion yuan under international standards.
In 1995, per share earnings were 0.94 yuan based on Chinese accounting standards.
The company proposed a cash dividend payment of 0.52 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
As called for under domestic regulations, trading in Konka's A and B shares for domestic and foreign investors will be suspended on Friday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
